caption: The drawing features a wooden cradle rendered in shades of brown, showcasing the natural grain and texture of the wood. The cradle is rectangular with vertical and horizontal panels forming the sides, ends, and bottom. Each corner is topped with a turned, rounded post, and the ends of the cradle feature raised rectangular panels. The cradle sits on two curved rockers, allowing it to rock back and forth. The background is plain and off-white, without any additional objects or decorations. The name "ULRICH FISCHER" is written in capital letters in the lower-left corner of the drawing. There are four small crosshairs lightly sketched around the cradle near the edges of the composition.
title: Cradle
